title: Zesty Rich Moroccan Gouda Cheese Briouat Bake
description: A rich and crumbly Moroccan dish featuring Gouda cheese, perfect for a lacto-vegetarian friendly meal. This briouat bake is indulgent and full of flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until softened.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked onion and garlic, Gouda cheese, parsley, salt, and pepper, and mix well.
Layer the filo dough in a large baking dish, brushing each layer with olive oil.
Spoon the cheese mixture over the filo dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Fold the filo dough over the cheese mixture, brushing with olive oil to seal.
Bake the briouat for 35 minutes, or until golden brown.
Let the briouat rest for 10 minutes before serving.
